project.name: OpenDating
project.description: A dating app with Tinder-quality UX built on decentralized infrastructure. Your identity belongs to you, your exact location never leaves your device, and your messages are end-to-end encrypted. No surveillance, no data harvesting, no central server that owns your profile.
project.audience: people who want genuine dating without surveillance capitalism
differentiators: Self-sovereign identity — you own your account, not a company
Coarse location only — your exact GPS never reaches the server
End-to-end encrypted messages — nobody can read your conversations
Private likes — one-way likes are never public
Private blocks and reports — enforced server-side, never notified
No ads, no data harvesting, no surveillance business model
Portable profile — export your key and move to any OpenDating client
